issues.description: download_and_untar.sh fails to exit on missing unzip or bad arg count
issues.detail: Lines 9-11 warn when unzip is missing but do not exit, and lines 13-21 print usage on bad arg count without exiting. Under set -euo pipefail, execution continues into realpath $1 with possibly unset $1, producing confusing errors instead of a clear diagnostic. Add `exit 1` after both messages.

issues.description: README links to a non-existent config path under conf/train/
issues.detail: README.md references `./conf/train/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml`, but the actual file is at `conf/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml` (no `train/` subdir). The link will 404 on GitHub for anyone clicking through to reproduce the recipe.

issues.description: Unquoted command substitutions in download_and_untar.sh break on paths with spaces
issues.detail: `extract_dir=$(realpath $1)` and `zip_dir=$(realpath ${2:-$extract_dir})` lack quotes. Paths containing spaces word-split into multiple args to realpath and fail. Quote as `realpath "$1"` and `realpath "${2:-$extract_dir}"`.

issues.description: data.sh sources download_and_untar.sh instead of executing it
issues.detail: data.sh uses `. ./local/download_and_untar.sh ...`, sourcing into the current shell. Any `exit` in the child terminates data.sh midway, and an empty `downloads_dir` default passes an empty positional that defeats the `${2:-$extract_dir}` default. Execute as a subprocess and ensure executable bit is set.

issues.description: Aggressive ad-hoc sed pipeline may corrupt transcripts and leaves inconsistent vocabulary
issues.detail: Transcript normalization strips `#`, `=`, and a partial list of CJK punctuation while only converting fullwidth `Ａ`. Other fullwidth letters and punctuation (！：；「」 etc.) remain, producing inconsistent vocab, and stripping `#`/`=` risks corrupting math content. Use a documented comprehensive normalization step.

issues.description: Hardcoded utterance counts will reject valid future dataset versions
issues.detail: data.sh hardcodes exact wav/line counts (22467/3208/6072/29386/38924) and exits on mismatch. Any upstream reissue, partial download, or filter step will fail with no recovery path. Make it a warning with a minimum threshold, or pin and document the exact dataset version in README.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees this is a standard ESPnet egs2 recipe addition (symlinks, configs, run.sh) whose core structure follows conventions, with all concerns concentrated in the bash data-prep scripts. The unanimous P0 is download_and_untar.sh missing `exit 1` after its missing-unzip and bad-arg-count warnings, which under `set -euo pipefail` masks the real failure. Unanimously flagged P1s include a broken README link to conf/train/ and unquoted realpath substitutions. Additional consensus P1s cover sourcing-vs-executing download_and_untar.sh, ad-hoc transcript normalization, and brittle hardcoded utterance counts. No issues touch ESPnet core code.
